title: jmri-json-oblock-client-message
description: Schema data object in message from client to JMRI for type "oblock"

userName.description: If present, set the user name of the OBlock

comment.description: If present, set the comment for the OBlock; null removes it

status.description: If present, 64 sets the out of service flag and 128 the track error flag, keeping the other flags; 2 (occupied), 4 (unoccupied), 16 (allocated) or 32 (running) replaces the whole status; 0 leaves it alone

value.description: If present, sets the value of the OBlock; null clears it

sensor.description: If present, the system name of the sensor that detects the OBlock; null removes it

train.description: If present, sets the train name in the warrant using the OBlock; null clears it. Returns an error if the OBlock has no warrant or the warrant is running
